title: Remove the std-only wire client from core
goal: Vision: V-9. CEO direction 2026-11-18: core under 25,000 lines; after the plug-in sandbox, move the MCP clients. susi-config's mcp_client stays: it is core's own forwarding path to Susi Commercial Apps. susi-wire-client (std-only MCP Streamable HTTP, host, HTTP and SSE client) has no caller in core beyond the susi_core::mcp_client and susi_gmcp re-exports; every user is in Susi Commercial Apps. Once Commercial Apps owns it with its tests and dependency-closure check (T-CLAUDEWIRE-1), delete core's copy, the re-exports and the closure test; correct every document and check that names it; and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING to the new measure.

reuse.searched: Core's susi-wire-client and susi-config mcp_client, and Susi Commercial Apps' agent-runtime mcp_client; the move deletes core's copy of the wire client in favour of the one Susi Commercial Apps already runs, adds no code and no dependency.
